plugin.name: Install the Enderal conversion plugin
plugin.description:
Adds "Zenderal - Relentless Sword.esp".
REQUIRES johnskyrim's Relentless Sword SE, installed separately for its meshes and textures - pick the CORE (runed) branch and whichever fire/ice glow intensity you prefer in HIS installer.
Then DISABLE "Relentless Sword SE - Johnskyrim.esp". It masters the Skyrim DLC, which Enderal does not load, and its recipes are gated on the Skyforge - it cannot work here. This plugin replaces it.
To forge the swords you need Handicraft 50 AND the blueprint, exactly like Enderal's own shadowsteel weapons.
"Blueprint: Relentless Sword (Handicraft 50)" sits on the noble shelf in Riverville Temple, and blacksmiths who deal in blueprints will stock it from level 30. One copy unlocks all six swords.
They temper at a sharpening wheel and dismantle back into shadowsteel at a smelter.
